unverifiable_exemptions: Tenant eligibility: age 62+ before the recording date, permanent disability, or 60%+ service-connected disabled veteran
coverage.summary: Applies to tenants in buildings converted or being converted to condominium, cooperative or fee-simple ownership. Protected tenancy requires age, disability or veteran status plus residence and income criteria. The conversion-cost rent bar applies to all tenants in the building.
coverage.other_conditions: Tenant must have lived in the building at least one year before the conversion recording date. Triggered by a conversion.

result.notes: The coverage values were kept unchanged. Every value is supported by verbatim spans from the D067 DCA guide. Each quote is kept to a single line of the source to avoid line-break mismatches, and the guide's 'd ate' typo is preserved. No unit-count, construction-date or owner thresholds for this Act appear in the documents. The two-or-more-unit language in N.J.S.A. 2A:18-61.1(k) belongs to the Anti-Eviction Act, so it was not imported. The tenant age, disability, veteran and income criteria are tenant facts that cannot be verified from building data. That is why requires_unknown_facts stays true.
